name: 18201 · Hazleton, PA
findings: ZIP 18201 (Hazleton) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18201 (Hazleton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
